verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own repository rulesets control what can happen on matching branches and tags: they can require pull requests, reviews and passing checks, block deletion and force pushes, and enforce CODEOWNERS approval. That is real but narrow branch-level governance, and nothing shows role or permission assignment at the other levels the story names. Missing for 10: organization-level roles/permissions, project-level permissions, repository-level member/team permission assignment, environment-level permissions, per-user/team branch push permissions, independent corroboration.
